definitions.explanation: A fixed amount of pay received each month for employment.

examples.japanese: {月給|げっきゅう}は25{万円|まんえん}だ。
{月給|げっきゅう}は{毎月|まいつき}25{日|にち}に{振|ふ}り{込|こ}まれる。
examples.english: The monthly salary is deposited on the 25th of each month.

examples.japanese: {月給制|げっきゅうせい}で{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: I work on a monthly salary system.

notes:
{月給|げっきゅう} is a compound: {月|げつ} (month) + {給|きゅう} (salary).

CONTRAST WITH OTHER PAY TYPES:
- {月給|げっきゅう} (monthly salary)
- {時給|じきゅう} (hourly wage)
- {日給|にっきゅう} (daily wage)
- {年俸|ねんぽう} (annual salary)
- {週給|しゅうきゅう} (weekly wage)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月給|げっきゅう}をもらう (to receive monthly salary)
- {月給|げっきゅう}が{上|あ}がる (salary goes up)
- {月給制|げっきゅうせい} (monthly salary system)

NOTE:
{月給|げっきゅう} typically refers to base salary before deductions. {手取|てど}り (take-home pay) is what one actually receives after taxes and insurance are deducted.
